summary: What happened to me in 3-74 was that for some reason (e.g., orthomolecular vitamins, I was possessed by the mimicker) I could see the mimicker and its mimicry. So in a way, what really happened is very simple. Always it strives to cause its intrusions, etc., to appear part of the normal world; I would guess that it occupied me briefly in order to cause me to do certain good things I would not on my own have doneâ€”and then departed, preferring us to have autonomy. It works principally on our percept system, so that we _think_ we see the phenomenal things (but they are actually Dokosâ€” alive, part of the mimicking organism). It switched my 1974 personality with an A.D. 70 personality. The lovely AI voice, however, with itsâ€”it can enter us and imitate us (to other people), but I, being occupied, knew it, without understanding it. This is a very high order of mimicry by a tutelary entity that loves us: it has knowledge but no direct powerâ€”except that it can affect the causal chains for a good, purposeful outcome by occupying (assimilating) this or that object, not necessarily permanently. Rather than calling it God I'd prefer to call it a higher life form.
